summary: xAI expanded Grok Build, its natural-language app-building feature, from an Early Beta limited to SuperGrok Heavy subscribers to general availability across all plans on web, iOS and Android, adding publishing to grok.me links, remix, custom domains, GitHub export, secrets storage, connectors, and in-app API access to Grok models.

practices.reason: Apps built with Grok Build can now call Grok's chat, image and voice APIs directly with managed credentials, changing how a developer would wire third-party API access into an app.
practices.quote: Turn on the SpaceXAI APIs for an app and it can call Grok for chat, images, and voice from inside its own code — no keys to create, paste, or rotate.
